file_number: The PATH or SAPH file number stamped on the page (format NN-HXXX-NNNNN).
authorization_number: The provincial authorisation number, labelled 'N° d'autorisation'. Null on federal-form documents.
statutory_paragraphs: Which paragraphs of the Fisheries Act this authorization is issued under, from the title line - for example 'Paragraphs 34.4(2)(b) and 35(2)(b)'.
date_of_issuance: The date this authorization was issued, from the signature block beside 'Approved by' and the Regional Director General's name. Not a validity period, not a condition deadline. Format YYYY-MM-DD.
related_authorizations: Each other PATH/SAPH authorization this document names. One component per authorization, holding the file number and one of: 'amends', 'amended by', 'supersedes', 'superseded by', 'referenced'. Where the relationship is stated in words the list does not cover, use 'referenced' and let the quote carry the wording.
proponent: The party the authorization is issued to. Organisation name only.
project_description: What the proposed project is, from 'Description of Proposed Project'.
project_location: Where the project is, from 'Location of Proposed Project' / 'Lieu du projet'. Quote that field alone. The community, watercourse and coordinates printed beside it are separate fields and are not to be joined into this one.
province: The province or territory the project is in, read from the location of the proposed project. Write the name in full - 'Alberta', not 'AB' - whatever form the document uses. Not the province in the proponent's mailing address, which is often different.
nearest_community: The nearest community named on the form.
waterbody: Each watercourse or waterbody named as affected by the works. One component per waterbody. Null where the form names none.
coordinates: Longitude/latitude or UTM coordinates as printed. One component per set where the document gives coordinates for more than one site.
death_of_fish_activities: The activities the document says are likely to result in the death of fish by means other than fishing (the s.34.4 clause). Quote the clause in full rather than its opening; where two readings of the same clause differ only in how much they quoted, both have failed. Where the document carries no such heading but states it in a sentence, record that sentence. Null where the document does not address the death of fish at all - many authorizations do not.
habitat_impact_activities: The activities the document says are likely to result in the harmful alteration, disruption or destruction of fish habitat (the s.35 clause). Quote the clause in full rather than its opening. Where the document carries no such heading but states the impacts in a sentence - 'destruction of 91,400 square metres of fish habitat' - record that sentence. The clause is what the document says, not where it is printed.
hadd_destruction_m2: Area of fish habitat authorized to be destroyed, in square metres. Where the document states one figure, that figure is the value. Where it lists several, each is a component with its own quote, and the value is the document's own stated total or null if it states none.
hadd_alteration_m2: Area authorized to be altered, in square metres. Same rule: one figure is the value; several are components and the value is a stated total or null.
hadd_disturbance_m2: Area authorized to be disrupted or disturbed, in square metres. Same rule: one figure is the value; several are components and the value is a stated total or null.
total_impact_area_m2: The sum of the areas authorized to be destroyed, altered and disturbed, where the document states that sum itself. Do not add the figures up yourself; that is what components are for.
project_footprint_area_m2: The total area the works occupy, in square metres, but only where the document gives a figure that is not the authorized harm. A stated footprint equal to the destruction, alteration and disturbance added together is that sum and belongs in total_impact_area_m2, leaving this field null. Fill it only where the two genuinely differ - a dredge footprint of 15,903 m2 against 8,643 m2 of authorized harm. Never record one figure in both fields.
impact_other_units: An area or length of fish habitat the authorization permits harm to, expressed in a unit other than square metres - hectares, linear metres, kilometres of watercourse. One component per figure, each recording the number and the unit exactly as printed. Do not record: volumes such as dredge cubic metres, percentages such as a reduction in flow, dimensions of structures rather than of habitat, or a figure already recorded in a hadd_ field and merely restated in another unit.
species_at_risk_finding: What the document records about species at risk, as one of: 'none identified' where it says no listed species were identified; 'present' where it names one or more and records no determination; 'not likely to adversely affect' where DFO records that determination; 'critical habitat' where it places the works in designated critical habitat, whether or not it also says no individuals were identified; 'other' where the document says something none of these covers, in which case the quote must carry its wording. Null where the document does not address species at risk. A document can say more than one of these - it can report no individuals found and still place the works in critical habitat. Where it does, answer with every one that applies as a list, and let species_at_risk_named carry the species.
species_at_risk_named: Each species at risk the document names, with its status and population where given - 'Channel Darter (Percina copelandi), Lake Ontario population, Endangered'. One component per species. Null where none is named, which is not the same as the document saying none were identified; that goes in species_at_risk_finding.
authorization_valid_from: The date the authorization takes effect, as YYYY-MM-DD. Where the form gives the start as the date of issuance rather than printing a separate date - 'From the date signed by the Regional Director General' - record the issuance date itself, quoting the signature block, and set confidence 'low'. Do not record the phrase; it is not a date and two readers given that choice will not make it the same way.
authorization_valid_to: The end of the validity period. Format YYYY-MM-DD.
timing_windows: Any restriction on when work may be carried out - in-water work windows, seasonal closures, spawning-period restrictions.
offsetting_is_required: Whether the authorization requires offsetting: 'yes', 'no', 'partial' where it is required for some of the works and not others, or null where the document does not address it. Never a quantity - the amounts have their own fields.
offsetting_measures: What the offsetting consists of: the works to be built, or the habitat to be created, restored or enhanced, and where. A phrase or a sentence, quoted.
offsetting_ratio: Each offsetting ratio stated, for example '1.75 offsetting units : 1 HADD unit' or '2:1'. One component per ratio where the document sets different ratios for different works. Fill only where offsetting_is_required is 'yes' or 'partial'.
offsetting_required_amount: The quantity of habitat the authorization requires the offsetting to produce - the figure the document says must be offset. Where the clause states a total and then shows how it was reached, as in 'to offset the serious harm to 189,300 m2 (91,400 m2 at a 1:1 ratio and 195,800 m2 at a 0.5:1 ratio)', the total is the answer and the ratio components are not; they belong to offsetting_ratio and to the hadd_ fields. What a named offsetting project will deliver is not this field either - that is offsetting_provided_amount. Fill only where offsetting_is_required is 'yes' or 'partial'.
offsetting_provided_amount: The quantity of habitat the offsetting works are stated to deliver - 'this project will account for 30,200 m2', '1,725 m2 reef', '3.5 km of stream'. One entry per project or figure. This is what is offered, never what is demanded; the demanded figure is offsetting_required_amount, and the two can differ. Where the document gives a range or a minimum, record it as printed. Null where no quantity is stated.
habitat_bank_name: The name of any habitat bank the offsetting draws on. Fill only where offsetting_is_required is 'yes' or 'partial'.
offsetting_completion_deadline: When the offsetting must be complete, as printed - a date or year ('by December 31, 2025'), or counted from an event ('within two years of completion of the works'). One component per deadline where different offsetting works carry different ones. Fill only where offsetting_is_required is 'yes' or 'partial'.
letter_of_credit_required: Whether a letter of credit or equivalent financial security is required: 'yes', 'no', 'partial' where it is required for some of the works and not others, or null. Answer 'partial' rather than 'yes' where the document names which works it covers, and quote the sentence that draws the line. If the form carries the field but leaves it blank, answer null with reason 'blank_on_form'.
letter_of_credit_amount: The amount of the financial security, as printed with its currency. One component per amount where the security is staged or split across works. Fill only where letter_of_credit_required is 'yes' or 'partial'.
monitoring_duration: How long monitoring must continue, in the document's own words. One entry per distinct statement, and where a document sets different periods for different works, each gets its own entry. Documents say this however suits them - a span counted from an event, an end date, a schedule of years, a reporting timetable that runs to a stated year - and whichever form the document uses is the answer. Record it as printed.
monitoring_frequency: How often monitoring must be carried out, in the document's own words. Quote the shortest phrase that states it - 'annually', 'weekly', 'at least twice over three years' - without a leading article or preposition, so that 'on a yearly basis' is recorded as 'yearly basis'. Where the same frequency appears in more than one place, quote the one in the monitoring condition itself. One entry per distinct frequency, and a document setting different frequencies for different works gets one each. How often a report is due belongs to the reporting condition that requires it, on the Conditions sheet.
incorporated_plans: Third-party or proponent plans the authorization makes binding by reference, with their versions and dates where given.
external_instruments: A permit, licence, certificate or approval issued by another authority that this document names - a provincial fish rescue permit, a municipal approval. Do not record: DFO's own guidance and codes of practice, which are incorporated_plans; statutes and regulations named as law, which are other_statutes; and the standard sentence that this authorization does not exempt the holder from complying with other legislation, which every document carries and which names nothing.
other_statutes: Any Act or Regulation the document names as applying to the works, beyond the Fisheries Act itself - the Species at Risk Act, the Metal and Diamond Mining Effluent Regulations. One component per instrument. Where the document ties a figure or a schedule to it, quote that with it.
approved_by_name: The name of the DFO signatory in the 'Approved by' block - the Regional Director General or their delegate. Not the proponent's signature, and not a name in a covering letter.
approved_by_title: The job title printed beneath the DFO signatory's name in the 'Approved by' block.
redaction_exemptions: Access to Information exemption markers appearing on these pages, for example 's.19(1)'. One component per marker, each quoting the marker where it appears with the page it is on. A marker appearing on several pages is one component per page. Null if none appear.
